context.fix_applied: A.5 step 2's non-empty branch now asserts that AT LEAST ONE :external_resource entry ends in '.rs' (Enum.any?/2 + String.ends_with?/2), replacing the prior 'every entry ends in .rs' assertion. The design text now explicitly states why: under this project's own always-on WASMEX_BUILD=true build configuration (.github/workflows/ci.yml:128, REQ-165), Wasmex.Native compiles through use Rustler's from-source path, whose Rustler.Compiler.Config.external_resources/3 (deps/rustler/lib/rustler/compiler/config.ex:85-93) globs the ENTIRE crate directory tree (rejecting only target/ and directories, no extension filter). The real vendored crate at deps/wasmex/native/wasmex/ confirms this: its external_resource list mixes .rs sources under src/ with non-.rs files the same glob sweeps in (README.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, .cargo/config.toml). An 'every entry ends in .rs' assertion is therefore false against this project's own real, mandated build path and would raise a real ExUnit.AssertionError. 'At least one entry ends in .rs' is the corrected, non-vacuous invariant: it still proves real Rust build inputs are genuinely tracked, without asserting anything about the composition of the rest of the list.
